_comment: Enable a real LLM provider (provider-agnostic). Set the matching API key env var before `aca service start` — OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / XAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY — then copy this to <data-dir>/config.json. Pick a model your account can access; nothing is hard-coded. `base_url` and `api_key_env` may be overridden if an endpoint or credential name differs.
